about.en: 4 is a community memecoin on BNB Smart Chain named after the "4" meme popularised by Binance founder Changpeng Zhao. It was launched through the Four.meme launchpad on 1 October 2025 as a BEP-20 token at 0x0a43fc31a73013089df59194872ecae4cae14444 with a 1,000,000,000 supply, and has no protocol or issuer behind it.
